name: CCM (Cognitive Codebase Matrix)
description: Reviews CCM code-graph indexing tools: background and blocking project indexing that writes index data into the project. Read-only navigation tools stay on inherit. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep index_project and index_now on Review: both write index artifacts into the project, and index_project can run heavy background indexing.
Read-only tools (map, explain, find_usages, impact_of_change, trace_call_chain, search_code, find_nodes, diff_context) stay on inherit; prefer them when the index is fresh.
